mentions.name: Serial
mentions.description: A FOSS RSS reader built to be more fun and less brutalist than existing technical, user-focused RSS reader options.
mentions.problem: Existing great FOSS RSS readers skew technical and brutalist, leaving little room for a friendlier, more fun option.
mentions.audience: Non-technical readers who want a friendlier alternative to technical, user-hostile RSS readers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on an RSS reader (https://github.com/megaflorasoftware/serial), trying to see if there’s room for a FOSS RSS reader that’s a bit more fun and less brutalist than the other great but more technical user-minded options out there

evidence.value: Working on an RSS reader (https://github.com/megaflorasoftware/serial), trying to see if there’s room for a FOSS RSS reader that’s a bit more fun and less brutalist than the other great but more technical user-minded options out there
